deltas.title_id: Peraturan Direktur Jenderal Pajak Nomor PER-12/PJ/2026 tentang Perubahan atas PER-11/PJ/2025 mengenai Pembetulan Surat Pemberitahuan Tahunan dan Tata Cara e-Bupot
deltas.title_en: Directorate General of Taxes Regulation PER-12/PJ/2026 amending PER-11/PJ/2025 on annual tax return (SPT Tahunan) amendment procedures and e-Bupot withholding certificate rules
deltas.impact_note: Taxpayers who file an amended (pembetulan) SPT Tahunan after already obtaining an installment/deferral approval for PPh Pasal 29 automatically lose that approval from the filing date of the amended return; e-Bupot withholding-certificate procedures are also revised. Clients with active installment/deferral plans should be advised before filing any SPT amendment.
deltas.summary: PER-12/PJ/2026 replaces parts of PER-11/PJ/2025: Article 129B declares any PPh Art. 29 installment/deferral approval void as soon as an amended annual tax return is submitted; the regulation separately revises e-Bupot (electronic withholding certificate) procedures.
deltas.verbatim_excerpt: Dalam hal Wajib Pajak melakukan pembetulan atas Surat Pemberitahuan Tahunan yang telah memperoleh surat keputusan persetujuan pengangsuran atau penundaan pembayaran Pajak Penghasilan Pasal 29, surat keputusan persetujuan pengangsuran atau penundaan tersebut dinyatakan tidak berlaku sejak Surat Pemberitahuan Tahunan pembetulan dimaksud disampaikan.
